name: Warlike Familiar

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Always prepare Battle Familiar with your Familiar Friend casting ability; cast it free once per Long Rest or using slots. Your familiar can use a Reaction when a creature within 5 feet is hit to add your PB to that creature’s AC against the attack.
